1.name: FOREST PATH
1.description: A WINDING DIRT PATH THROUGH DARK TREES. THE CASTLE LOOMS AHEAD TO THE SOUTH.

2.name: CASTLE GATE
2.description: AN IMPOSING IRON GATE BLOCKS YOUR WAY. IT'S LOCKED. TO THE NORTH IS THE FOREST PATH.

3.name: COURTYARD
3.description: CRUMBLING STONE COURTYARD WITH A DRY FOUNTAIN. DOORS LEAD NORTH TO THE GATE, SOUTH TO THE GREAT HALL, AND EAST TO THE KITCHEN.

4.name: GREAT HALL
4.description: A VAST HALL WITH TATTERED BANNERS ON THE WALLS. A WIZARD STANDS IN THE CORNER, STUDYING AN ANCIENT TOME.

5.name: KITCHEN
5.description: AN OLD KITCHEN WITH RUSTY POTS, PANS, AND PLENTY OF SHINY OBJECTS. A DOOR LEADS WEST BACK TO THE COURTYARD.

6.name: SECRET PASSAGE
6.description: A NARROW STONE PASSAGE LIT BY TORCHES. THIS MUST BE THE HIDDEN PASSAGE FROM THE CASTLE.

7.name: DUNGEON
7.description: A DANK UNDERGROUND CHAMBER FILLED WITH COBWEBS. THE AIR SMELLS OF ROT AND DECAY.

8.name: TREASURE VAULT
8.description: THE CASTLE'S TREASURE VAULT! GOLD GLITTERS IN THE DARKNESS.

SWORD.name: RUSTY SWORD
SWORD.description: AN OLD SWORD WITH A DULL BLADE. STILL SHARP ENOUGH TO BE USEFUL.

KEY.name: BRASS KEY
KEY.description: A SMALL ORNATE KEY. IT LOOKS LIKE IT MIGHT FIT THE IRON GATE.

GATE.name: IRON GATE
GATE.description: A HEAVY GATE WITH A LARGE KEYHOLE. IT BLOCKS THE ENTRANCE TO THE CASTLE.

BEAST.name: FEARSOME BEAST
BEAST.description: A HUGE SNARLING CREATURE WITH RAZOR CLAWS AND GLOWING RED EYES. IT BLOCKS THE WAY SOUTH.

TREASURE.name: GOLDEN CHALICE
TREASURE.description: A MAGNIFICENT GOLDEN CHALICE! IT'S ENCRUSTED WITH JEWELS.

messages.WIZARD_GREETING: THE WIZARD LOOKS UP FROM HIS TOME. 'AH, A BRAVE ADVENTURER! BRING ME THE GOLDEN CHALICE FROM THE VAULT BELOW AND I SHALL REWARD YOU HANDSOMELY.'

responses.message: THE GATE HAS A LARGE KEYHOLE AND LOOKS VERY HEAVY.
THE KEY LOOKS LIKE IT MIGHT FIT THE IRON GATE.
IT'S OLD AND RUSTY, BUT STILL SHARP.
THE CHALICE IS BEAUTIFUL AND WORTH A FORTUNE!
A HUGE SNARLING BEAST BLOCKS YOUR PATH SOUTH!
THE BEAST LIES DEFEATED ON THE DUNGEON FLOOR.
THE KEY TURNS IN THE LOCK! THE GATE CREAKS OPEN. A SECRET PASSAGE IS REVEALED!
YOU SLASH AT THE BEAST! IT FALLS DEFEATED!
YOU SLASH AT THE BEAST! IT FALLS DEFEATED!
YOU PRESENT THE GOLDEN CHALICE TO THE WIZARD. HE SMILES KNOWINGLY AND THANKS YOU.
